vocabulary.meaning: technology that can think and learn like humans
a new idea, device, or method
the science of making and using robots
using machines to do work automatically
a computer-made world you can experience
a set of rules a computer follows
an important new discovery or development
a system that connects computers or people

grammar_tips.title: Describing Processes
grammar_tips.explanation: Use passive voice to explain how technology is used. Example: Data is collected by sensors.

grammar_tips.title: Speculating About the Future
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'will', 'might', or 'could' to talk about future technology. Example: Robots might replace many jobs.

example_sentences.sentence: Artificial intelligence is changing many industries.
A new breakthrough was made in robotics last year.
Automation can increase efficiency in factories.
People use virtual reality to experience new worlds.
